description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Ace], & MAG +500 to user
TP Max: AOE Fire/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Ace
description.text: Fire abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times and don't consume ability uses, Fire abilities ignore 20% of the target's DEF and RES, keeps track of the number of Fire abilities used, removes [Tactical Awoken Mode] after using 8 Fire abilities, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
One single piercing attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user.
Grants [Fire Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Fire Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical] to user, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has Attach Fire 0-1/2
WS Blue: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to user
WS Gold: Grants [Fire Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Fire Quick Cast (Tactical)] to user
